title: Tour: funsies.fun
intro: A short look at funsies.fun in screenshots of the site itself, with our own words for each one. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

steps.say: Screenshots only, nothing is sent. Everything here exists to have fun.
Each game opens right on the page, full screen. Fennsmash, the smash game. A Reaction App test of your reactions. A tensegrity physics sim where you pluck a living structure.
Press a button and watch the page misbehave. It always puts itself back.
